links.comparator_used: No head-to-head comparison with manual review alone; classifier performance was measured against ground-truth DSC thresholds on the prospective test cohort
links.outcome: Detection of failed GTV auto-contours (DSC below threshold) from radiomic features of the segmented GTV
links.effect: Logistic Regression on test cohort (T = 0.67 on DSC): precision 0.88, recall 0.75, F1 0.81, accuracy 0.86
links.tradeoff: Recall of 0.75 means some poor contours are missed; the study does not report added workload or cost.
links.quote: Failure detection could generate precision ( P = 0.88  ), recall ( R = 0.75  ), F1-score ( F = 0.81  ), and accuracy ( A = 0.86  ) using Logistic Regression (LR) classifier on the test cohort with a threshold T = 0.67 on DSC values.

design_hint: failure detection of auto-segmentation contours using radiomic classifiers
